items.q: I don't know. Everybody calls him Fennimore. I think his name is James Fennimore.

ctx.x: Is it Something Fennimore or Fennimore Something?
I don't know. Everybody calls him Fennimore. I think his name is James Fennimore.
Just one other thing. In the days when you were... Well, even here in Dallas. But in the 30's and 40's, a lot of the clubs were run by gangsters.
